english.note: Use this when “voice” means the right or ability to express an opinion and have it considered, rather than a ballot.

exampleSentences.english: Those residents finally have a voice.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰班街坊終於有發言權喇。

english.note: Use this when the focus is on having the right or opportunity to speak in a discussion or decision.

exampleSentences.english: At this meeting, everyone has the right to speak and have a say.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次開會，人人都有發言權。
